claims.content: The C² JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) of an Interface Unit (IU) when specific criteria are met, such as the lack of recent J2 PPLI messages or the receipt of a Drop Track message.

goal.raw_text: The C² JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) of an Interface Unit (IU) when specific criteria are met, such as the lack of recent J2 PPLI messages or the receipt of a Drop Track message.

claims.content: C2 JU
A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds.
A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence.
A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU.
The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

The C² JU assumes reporting responsibility of an Interface Unit when a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, a J2 PPLI message with Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence is received, a J7.0 Drop Track message is received, or the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

trigger.raw_text: The C² JU assumes reporting responsibility of an Interface Unit when a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, a J2 PPLI message with Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence is received, a J7.0 Drop Track message is received, or the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

claims.content: The C² JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) of an Interface Unit (IU) in accordance with reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data and one of the trigger conditions occurs (e.g., J2 PPLI timeout, NPS Indicator set to Inactive/Conditional Radio Silence, J7.0 Drop Track received, or Geodetic Position Quality set to 0).
Upon assuming R², the C² JU reports the IU as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.
The type of surveillance message used depends upon the Environment/Category of the IU being reported.
The Identity of the IU shall be reported as Friend.
The Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported.
The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1, and shall be maintained if another C² JU assumes R² of the IU.
If a correlation is not found and J2 messages are not received subsequently with no local data, the C² JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

If position or other data in a PPLI meet decorrelation criteria, the C² JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with a new track number and report the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field as No Statement.

A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.

A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure from a JU that has R² of a locally held track may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received.

A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.

A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point.

If a correlation is not found between the received J2 PPLI report and local sensor data, and no subsequent J2 messages are received while the C² JU still has no local data, the C² JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

If position or other data in a PPLI meet decorrelation criteria, the C² JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with a new track number and report the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field as No Statement.
A JU relinquishes Reporting Responsibility (R²) for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote Track Quality (TQ) is greater than the local TQ.

A JU relinquishes Reporting Responsibility (R²) for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Station Number (STN) is greater than the local STN.
The C² JU reports the Interface Unit (IU) as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.
The type of surveillance message used depends upon the Environment/Category of the IU being reported.
The Identity of the IU is reported as Friend.
The Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages are reported.
The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator are reported as value 1, and this value is maintained if another C² JU assumes R² of the IU.
